name: week
title: The media desk this week
subtitle: Internal working report. Times are UTC. Nothing sends.

sections.title: Response deadlines
sections.sql: select code,subject,owner,to_char(deadline at time zone 'UTC','YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') as deadline_utc,attention,statement from deadline_desk order by deadline

sections.title: Follow-ups
sections.sql: select code,inquiry,owner,task,to_char(due_at at time zone 'UTC','YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') as due_utc,attention from followup_desk where completed_at is null order by due_at

sections.title: Current versions
sections.sql: select code,title,revision,to_char(embargo_until at time zone 'UTC','YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') as embargo_utc,approved_by,readiness from release_calendar order by code
sections.note: Approved draft available means the statement passed the local record checks. A person still reviews its use.

sections.title: Relationships
sections.sql: select code,name,organisation,status,open_inquiries,attention from relationship_review order by code

sections.title: Review findings
sections.sql: select * from compliance_review order by code,rule
